title: Boundary walls on one lot boundary only, R10-R17.5
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, number of boundaries: R10 - R17.5 One.

replaces.note: Part B had no deemed-to-comply boundary walls at R10-R17.5 except abutting existing walls (C4P1-092)

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#count-r10-r17.5. Table 3.4c (p34) values unchanged from Chapter 3; the clause text now cites C3.8.1 for overshadowing. One boundary (Table 3.4c). Low relevance to multi-storey apartments (C4P1-092).
